key_points: SoFi Bank launches first U.S. bank-issued stablecoin (SoFiUSD) settlement on Mastercard network.
Settlement covers SoFi's $25B card program, indicating significant volume adoption.
Partnership validates Mastercard's network for emerging digital currency use cases.
Could drive incremental transaction revenue and network expansion in crypto/stablecoin space.
No negative news; recent price move -1.9% appears unrelated to fundamentals.
